title: Broncos sign former UFL CB/KR Sean Fresch

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos sign former UFL CB/KR Sean Fresch
sources.description: According to multiple reports, including 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, the Denver Broncos have signed former UFL cornerback and returner Sean Fresch. To make room for him on the 90-man roster, the team has waived cornerback Paul Manning. Fresch is a 5-8, 173-pound cornerback and returner who had 2 sacks, 3 TFLs, and 4 PBUs this […]
